products.name: Enablement Kit — Microsoft Defender for Office 365 — Commercial
products.short_description: Level up your team on Microsoft Defender for Office 365 — a structured enablement enablement kit with concepts, hands-on labs, and a take-home runbook.
products.description:
Level up your team on Microsoft Defender for Office 365 — a structured enablement enablement kit with concepts, hands-on labs, and a take-home runbook.

Tools only pay off when the team can drive them. This enablement kit enables your admins/SOC on Microsoft Defender for Office 365: how it works, the console and workflows, and guided hands-on labs — Threat Explorer & investigations; anti-phish/Safe Links/Attachments; Attack Simulation; automated investigation — so the team operates it confidently instead of guessing.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Threat Explorer & investigations
  • anti-phish/Safe Links/Attachments
  • Attack Simulation
  • automated investigation
  • Guided hands-on labs and sample queries

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A team that confidently operates Microsoft Defender for Office 365 — concepts internalized, labs completed, and a runbook to keep.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WSMDO-Discovery.ps1 — inventory workshop readiness for Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (read-only)
    • WSMDO-Report.ps1 — report MDO workshop cohort progress and per-lab email-data availability (read-only)
    • WSMDO-RunLab.ps1 — run a chosen email hunting-lab query from WSMDO-Labs.kql read-only
    • WSMDO-Validate.ps1 — run the MDO workshop pass/fail gates and score the knowledge-check (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
